decision.comment: Profiling stage is clean and internally consistent. All deterministic checks pass with an empty deterministic_findings list. Key verifications: (1) Image shape 28×28×3 matches the standard MedMNIST distribution; (2) Split sizes (89996/10004/7180) exactly match official PathMNIST splits with no subsampling (official_data_fraction=1.0, profiled_fraction=1.0); (3) 9-class multi-class schema is coherent with the label list in the dataset manifest; (4) Class proportions between train and validation are nearly identical (max deviation <0.001), confirming no split-level distribution shift; (5) Imbalance ratio of 1.63 is modest; (6) Zero duplicate train samples and zero blank images; (7) Channel statistics (mean ≈ [0.74, 0.53, 0.71], std ≈ [0.12, 0.18, 0.12]) are reasonable for normalized RGB histopathology patches. The identified ambiguity risks (background/debris/mucus overlap, adipose vs. background, smooth muscle vs. stroma, mucosa vs. adenocarcinoma, lymphocytes vs. debris) are inherent to 28×28 resolution and multi-tissue patch labeling, not pipeline errors. The cross-domain test set (different clinical center) is properly flagged, and the OOD aggregate methodology (arithmetic mean of per-severity AUROCs) is correctly specified. The only minor observation is that llm_model_digest is null for qwen3.8, meaning exact LLM weights are not pinned in the manifest; this is explicitly noted as an auxiliary, non-blocking concern and does not affect the deterministic profiling results. No issues warrant revision or stop. Proceed to the next stage.
